title: Tellent Recruitee integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Tellent Recruitee
Tellent Recruitee is a collaborative hiring platform built to simplify and optimise recruitment. It allows teams to manage job postings, track candidates and collaborate throughout the hiring pipeline. With a user-friendly interface and automation capability, Recruitee helps recruiters minimise manual tasks and make faster, data-backed hiring decisions.
Why Integrate Recruitee with Xobin?
Integrating Recruitee with Xobin embeds skill-based assessments directly into your hiring workflow. Recruiters can send assessments, monitor candidate progress and access detailed performance reports without switching platforms. This integration helps you:
Automate candidate screening with skill-based assessments.
Eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
Improve hiring accuracy with objective evaluation data.
Accelerate decision-making with real-time insight.
Steps to Integrate Recruitee with Xobin
Access integrations in Xobin
Log in to your Xobin account and navigate to
Settings > Integrations
Search for
Recruitee
in the available integrations list.
Generate the API key
Click
Connect Recruitee
and generate your unique API key.
Copy the API key
Copy the generated key securely. It is required during setup in Recruitee.
Open the Recruitee Marketplace
Log in to your Recruitee account and navigate to the
Marketplace
section.
Search for Xobin
Find
Xobin
in the Marketplace and select it to begin setup.
Start the integration
Integrate
to initiate the connection between both platforms.
Complete the integration
Accept the terms and conditions, paste the API key generated in Xobin and click
to finalise the setup.
Who is this integration for?
The Recruitee and Xobin integration is ideal for recruiters, HR managers and talent acquisition teams who want skill-based assessments in their hiring process. It is especially beneficial for organisations aiming to streamline candidate evaluation, reduce time-to-hire and improve hiring quality through structured workflows. It suits:
Startups and growing companies scaling their hiring processes.
Mid-sized and enterprise organisations seeking efficiency.
Recruitment agencies managing multiple candidates and roles.
Teams hiring for technical, non-technical or role-specific skills.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Marketplace installation
Xobin is listed in the Recruitee Marketplace, so setup is a search, an Integrate click and an API key paste.
Automated candidate screening
Send skill-based assessments as part of the pipeline instead of chasing candidates manually.
Real-time progress tracking
Monitor who has been invited and who has finished without leaving Recruitee.
Objective evaluation data
Detailed Xobin performance reports give collaborative hiring teams a shared, evidence-based view of each candidate.
Made for collaborative hiring
Shared assessment data gives every hiring team member in Recruitee the same evidence to decide on.
No engineering effort
Setup runs entirely from the marketplace listing, nothing to build, host or maintain.

Frequently asked questions
